purpose: Nasdaq-100 15 minute series (KXNDQ15M): the list of settled markets with closes from 2026-11-05T00:00Z to 2026-11-16T00:00Z, so the candle job can be built from real tickers. Development dates only; nothing in the file is read until a reader is allowed.
heldout: Development dates only, closes before 2026-11-16T00:00Z and always before the KXINX15M held-out cut 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z (HELDOUT_FIRST of SPXFV1 and SPXOI1, registry 8323d0b7). The Head of R&D approved the budget on 2026-11-16 15:30Z.
notes: Close window 2026-11-05T00:00Z to 2026-11-16T00:00Z (1793836800 to 1794787200). About 9 trading days of about 26 windows (weekdays about 14:00Z to 21:00Z) so one page of 1000 holds them; 3 pages is the budget. Nothing after 2026-11-16 is asked.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
